description: This file contains SCSS styles for the Bootstrap-based Navbar component, including styles for the navbar container, brand, navigation, text, responsive behavior, toggler button, and themes (light and dark). It defines styling rules and mixins for various parts of a responsive, themable Navbar used in a web application.
external_files: Bootstrap mixins (e.g., @include hover-focus, @include media-breakpoint-down, @include media-breakpoint-up, @include border-radius)
